status: Conditional passive measurement convention for review

source_state.omega: C^3 finite, ordered native channels; x=Re Omega, y=Im Omega
source_state.ema: optional separate variant: z_H=lambda_vp*rho*cos(3*(theta-ell))+m; m must be supplied

adoption.name: Uniform readout projection in registered frames
adoption.types: z is scalar. v in {M,C,T} is an ordered source readout triple in E_Z. A v is a virtual polar observation vector; no physical field or ambient axial interpretation of channel C is asserted.
adoption.dictionary: A=lambda*Rz(delta), lambda>0, delta fixed; same A for all triples, probes, pairs and local circle readings
adoption.probe: record_k={z, y_k^M, y_k^C, y_k^T}; y_k^v=B_k^T A v
adoption.no_spatial_law: A v is copied as one uniform virtual readout; no attenuation, propagation, deformation or flux is inferred
adoption.view_law: For passive U in O(3), A_prime=U A, B_prime=U B, n_prime=U n, tangent_prime=U tangent. Scalar records unchanged.
adoption.parity: An ambient AXIAL interpretation of C would require a different typed dictionary and compatible parity convention for T; not adopted

chosen_figure.provenance: Recovered illustrative array settings and previous median macro registration; no fit or physical calibration

domains.regular_state_rank: C!=0 and I>2*||C||, b!=0, kappa>0 -> rank 4 for all staged records; two-dimensional local fibre
domains.scalar_inverse: 0<=z/b<1, b!=0: kappa=z/(b-z); no claim of stable inversion near saturation or clock zero
domains.zero: Raw z,C,M,T and records are zero at Omega=0; direction undefined; norm-based scalar not differentiable there if b!=0
domains.clock_blind: b=0 loses norm from z; generic C-only rank is 3
domains.arithmetic: Real mathematical formulas; source numerical precision/overflow contracts remain separate

results.time: No motion or trajectory variable has been added

figure_fixture.description: Two algebraic states at one fixed clock, not consecutive trajectory states

candidate.name: OLD_RSB only
candidate.RSD_identity: unresolved; not equated with RSB or RGD
candidate.fit: Conditional psi[c,k,h] assignment on outer array if phase index m=k is explicitly adopted; channel/helicity labels are internal
candidate.input: Existing historical handoff still needs finite-record N and S or sufficient J history; z/C records alone insufficient
candidate.missing: receiver initial state, input/coupling map, update cadence, boundary/frame convention, energy balance/backreaction
